name: Fukushuu no Kyoushitsu Wana ni Ochita Shoujo "Kyouko"
original_name: 復讐の教室 罠に墜ちた少女『恭子』
source:
Kyouko was the popular kid in class.
But one day, after accidentally peeing during class, she becomes the target of bullying.
The girls treat her like a toy, forcing her to climax in the bathroom,
and the boys in her class rape her...
What will become of Kyouko?..
